fundamentals.name: ProShares Ultra VIX Short-Term Futures ETF
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: The index seeks to offer exposure to market volatility through publicly traded futures markets and is designed to measure the implied volatility of the S&P 500 over 30 days in the future.

news.paragraph: UVXY, an ETF designed to track volatility, has been the subject of recent articles discussing intraday trading strategies and its role as a hedging tool. While some articles highlight its utility in uncertain times, others suggest that "good things do not last," implying a cautionary stance on its long-term prospects. The ETF's leveraged nature means it is best suited for short-term tactical plays rather than buy-and-hold strategies.
